# WSCapp

WSCapp is a free unofficial World Scholar's Cup prep app for students at https://wscapp.app/.

It helps students prepare for the World Scholar's Cup with Challenge-style practice, Debate Lab, Alpacards, and a room-scoped multiplayer study campus.

WSCapp may include seasonal World Scholar's Cup theme content, but the app itself is evergreen. Its product positioning is WSC online campus: practice smarter, debate better, and study together.

Important pages:

- Home: https://wscapp.app/
- World Scholar's Cup prep: https://wscapp.app/world-scholars-cup-prep/
- WSC practice: https://wscapp.app/wsc-practice/
- Debate Lab: https://wscapp.app/debate-lab/
- Scholar's Challenge practice: https://wscapp.app/scholars-challenge/
- Alpacards: https://wscapp.app/alpacards/
- Multiplayer campus: https://wscapp.app/multiplayer-campus/

Disclaimer:

WSCapp is an unofficial free companion app for World Scholar's Cup preparation. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the World Scholar's Cup.
